name: issue-pilot
description: Picks up a GitHub, Jira or Linear issue, sizes it with smart-router, works it in a dedicated session and opens the PR.

provider.title: Issue tracker
provider.description: auto: Linear when its key is set, else Jira when it is configured, else GitHub when the git remote is on GitHub.

assignedToMe.title: Only my issues
assignedToMe.description: List the open issues assigned to you (switchable in the Issues tab).

label.title: Label filter
label.description: Only issues with this label (switchable in the Issues tab).

milestone.title: Milestone filter
milestone.description: Only issues in this milestone (GitHub), fix version (Jira) or cycle/project (Linear).

autoPR.title: Open the draft PR without asking
autoPR.description: When autopilot reports the issue done and the tests pass, commit, push and open the draft PR on its own. Off: it waits for your click.

startComment.title: Comment when starting
startComment.description: Post a short "working on it" comment on the issue when you press Start.

finishComment.title: Comment when the PR opens
finishComment.description: Post a summary comment with the PR link on the issue.

inProgressLabel.title: In-progress label (GitHub)
inProgressLabel.description: Added to a GitHub issue when you start it; created if the repository lacks it. Empty: no label.

testCommand.title: Test command
testCommand.description: Run before the PR opens. Empty: detected (npm/pnpm/yarn/bun test, pytest, go test, cargo test).

jiraBaseUrl.title: Jira URL
jiraBaseUrl.description: Your Jira Cloud site, e.g. https://acme.atlassian.net

jiraEmail.title: Jira account email
jiraEmail.description: The email of the account the API token belongs to.

jiraApiToken.title: Jira API token
jiraApiToken.description: Create one at id.atlassian.com → Security → API tokens. Kept in secure storage.

jiraJql.title: Extra JQL
jiraJql.description: Added to the search with AND, e.g. project = SHOP.

jiraStartStatus.title: Jira status on Start
jiraStartStatus.description: The transition taken when you start an issue.

jiraReviewStatus.title: Jira status when the PR opens
jiraReviewStatus.description: The transition taken when the draft PR opens (skipped when the workflow has none by this name).

linearApiKey.title: Linear API key
linearApiKey.description: A personal API key (Linear → Settings → Security & access). Kept in secure storage.

linearReviewState.title: Linear state when the PR opens
linearReviewState.description: The workflow state set when the draft PR opens (skipped when the team has none by this name).
